newsitem.title: CHINA: CATHAY SHARES MAY SOFTEN AFTER RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CATHAY SHARES MAY SOFTEN AFTER RESULTS.

text.p: Cathay Pacific shares could see some softness on Thursday after the company posted a 35 percent drop in interim earnings, but brokers said they did not see much downside because investors had expected poor results.
"They might come off a little bit but the bad news is already in the price," said Geoff Galbraith, institutional sales trader at NAVA SC Securities.

Cathay Pacific reported net profit for the first six months of the year of HK$1.07 billion compared with HK$1.65 billion in the same 1996 period. The stock fell HK$0.20 to HK$14.00 on Wednesday ahead of the announcement and HK$0.45 on Tuesday.
